acme/fjord-bank/fjord-bank-contract.md:
# Fjord Bank contract

Type: contract

- Fjord Bank's contract renews on 1 January 2027.
- Either side can end it with three months' notice.
- The price is 1.2 million NOK a year.
- Kari Lie, Fjord Bank's CFO, signs anything above 100,000 NOK.
acme/fjord-bank/kari-lie.md:
# Kari Lie

Type: person

- Kari Lie is Fjord Bank's CFO.
- Kari wants a written summary after every meeting.
acme/northwind/overview.md:
# Northwind

Northwind is Acme's largest client. This autumn the work is the website relaunch, sponsored by Gunnar Holm and going live on 1 March 2027.
acme/northwind/website-relaunch/accessib:
# Accessibility

- The site must meet WCAG 2.1 AA, which Norwegian law requires.
- An outside audit is planned for February.
acme/northwind/website-relaunch/analytic:
# Analytics

- The new site uses Matomo instead of Google Analytics.
- Northwind wants the same monthly report as today.
acme/northwind/website-relaunch/content-:
# Content migration

- About 1,200 pages move from the old CMS.
- Product pages move first, news last.

# Content workshop, 7 October

Type: meeting

- Agreed which old pages to drop: about 40% of them.
- Northwind writes the new texts for the product pages.
acme/northwind/website-relaunch/decision:
# Decision: hosting on Azure

Type: decision

- Northwind chose Azure to host the new website, at the steering group meeting on 14 October.
- The reason: Northwind's IT team already runs Azure, and it keeps the data in Norway.
- AWS was the alternative. It was about 15% cheaper, but would have needed a new contract.
acme/northwind/website-relaunch/design-r:
# Design review, 23 September

Type: meeting

- Gunnar approved the new design.
- The product pages get larger images.
acme/northwind/website-relaunch/gunnar-h:
# Gunnar Holm

Type: person

- Gunnar Holm is Northwind's head of marketing and the sponsor of the website relaunch.
- Gunnar prefers email over calls, and short summaries over long reports.
- Gunnar joined Northwind in 2023 from Fjordline.
- Gunnar is easiest to reach before 9 in the morning.
# Hosting

- Staging runs on Azure from 1 November.
acme/northwind/website-relaunch/image-li:
# Image library

- Northwind buys photos from a stock library, with a licence until 2028.
acme/northwind/website-relaunch/kickoff-:
# Kickoff, 2 September

Type: meeting

- Kickoff with Gunnar, Per and Lise.
- Agreed to meet every other Tuesday.
acme/northwind/website-relaunch/lars-moe:
# Lars Moe

Type: person

- Lars Moe is the account manager at the CMS vendor.
acme/northwind/website-relaunch/launch-c:
# Launch checklist

- Redirects, analytics, cookie banner, DNS change, and a last content check.
acme/northwind/website-relaunch/lise-ber:
# Lise Berg

Type: person

- Lise Berg runs procurement at Northwind.
- Lise needs purchase orders before any invoice.
acme/northwind/website-relaunch/mona-lie:
# Mona Lie

Type: person

- Mona Lie is Northwind's lawyer.
- Mona reviews everything about cookies and personal data.
acme/northwind/website-relaunch/newslett:
# Newsletter

- The newsletter signup moves to the new site at launch.
acme/northwind/website-relaunch/old-cms-:
# Old CMS notes

- The old CMS is Episerver 7. Its licence ends in December 2026.
acme/northwind/website-relaunch/per-hans:
# Per Hansen

Type: person

- Per Hansen is Northwind's IT lead.
- Per wants changes to DNS announced a week ahead.
acme/northwind/website-relaunch/search-e:
# Search engine optimization

- Old addresses get redirects to the new pages.
- The redirect list is in the shared drive.
acme/northwind/website-relaunch/steering:
# Steering group meeting, 14 October

Type: meeting

- Present: Gunnar Holm, Per Hansen, Ana Berg and Cara Lund.
- Decided to host the new website on Azure.
- Decided to keep the go-live date of 1 March 2027.
- The next steering group meeting is on 11 November.
acme/northwind/website-relaunch/translat:
# Translations

- The site launches in Norwegian and English.
- Swedish comes later in 2027.
acme/northwind/website-relaunch/website-:
# Website relaunch

Type: project

- The relaunch goes live on 1 March 2027.
- The budget is 450,000 NOK, approved by Gunnar Holm on 2 October.
- Cara owns the content migration.
- Per Hansen at Northwind owns hosting and DNS.
- Risk: the CMS vendor's API allows only 10 requests a second, which slows the content migration. Lars at the vendor is looking into it.
- Risk: the cookie consent banner needs approval from Mona Lie in Northwind legal before launch.
- The design was approved at the design review on 23 September.
- Status on 15 October: 60% of the content is migrated.
- Gunnar hinted that the budget may grow by 100,000 NOK if the pilot goes well.
acme/office.md:
# Office

- The office is at Storgata 12 in Oslo.
- The meeting room Fjellet seats eight.
acme/time-sheets.md:
# Time sheets

- Time sheets are due every Friday at 15:00.
- Hours go on the client project, never on internal work.
